title: Backups and rollback
description: Snapshots of the mod folders and the mod settings. The manager takes one before every update and keeps the latest three.
emptyHint: Take a snapshot before experimenting with mods — a rollback brings everything back.
restoreTitle: Roll back to the snapshot of {date}?
restoreDescription: The folders return to the snapshot, other mods included. The game must be closed.
deleteDescription: Files in the game stay as they are.
